claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18650 35A 2500mAh 20A as a 2500mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.

The tested metallic-purple Efest IMR 18650 2500mAh revision is flat-top and unprotected; Battery Mooch identified it as a Hohm Work rewrap and rated it at 20A continuous despite the historical 35A model label.

The Efest IMR 18650 35A catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for Efest IMR 18650 35A in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
